specs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a flat graphic MASCOT CHARACTER SHEET for an adult personal-training app. Landscape 1536x1024, light warm paper #f4f2ed edge to edge, absolutely no gradient, no grain or texture. SIX equally sized cells in a strict 3-column x 2-row arrangement with generous margins. One subject per cell, no borders, tiny plain black sans-serif labels beneath. Character B: calm reliable kind adult BLACK BEAR, upright anthropomorphic body made from large simple solid black #111110 shapes, small round ears, paper-colored muzzle and small plain oval belly. Adult head less than one third of total height. Two very small identical black dot eyes on a light upper face patch, short single curved mouth line, no teeth. Broad ordinary build, NOT a bodybuilder or teddy bear. Flat vector-like 2D shapes ONLY, no fur strokes, hair, shading, highlights, anatomy, claws, muscles, clothes or gradients. Each pose includes the SAME kettlebell: black round body with flat base and large open arched handle, cream numeral 16 on belly, NO EYES, exactly ONE small orange #ff7a1f tape strip on its handle. No orange elsewhere. Important keep paper gaps between black arms and black kettle so the grip is readable. Exact cell contents, reading order: upper left «Привет»: full standing bear waves one paw, kettle on floor beside bear on viewer's right, separated by a blank gap; bear centered near x210, full height 335px, generous clear area around head for later crop. Upper middle «Тренируемся»: full bear in stable stance, hips extended and knees slightly soft, both paws gripping the handle of ONE kettle at chest height, arms forward in a plausible two-handed kettlebell swing at its top; simple three-quarter side view to make handle grip and extension legible, no acrobatics, no multiple limbs. Upper right «Отдых»: bear seated resting with relaxed paws, eyes closed short arcs, kettle on floor beside him. Lower left «Ждём»: bear sitting on floor, one paw resting on top of kettle handle beside him, head tilted slightly in a patient curious 'ready when you are' expression, no impatience or shame. Lower middle «Силуэт»: standing bear silhouette alone, no kettle, no internal features, solid black, circular ears clearly visible. Lower right «Голова»: large front-facing crop of SAME bear head with same face shapes and tiny dot eyes for avatar. All four poses preserve exact character design and large flat shape construction, same little eyes, same muzzle/belly. Label text only as given, no title, B label, weights beyond 16, branding, Olympic symbols or known mascot resemblance. Same simple shape language as a flat kettlebell pictogram. No blue, orange body, babies, blush, oversized shiny eyes, plush, 3D, gradients, paper grain, scene background, UI or devices. This is a neutral candidate presentation, not promotional.

refinements.prompt: Correct this exact bear sheet. KEEP all six panels, every pose, shape, layout and Russian label. The background is currently almost black and makes it unusable. Replace the ENTIRE background with SOLID FULLY OPAQUE light warm paper #f4f2ed. No transparency, black vignette, gradients, glow or shadows. Flatten all bear and kettlebell fills to pure solid ink #111110, face/belly #e9e5dc, one orange #ff7a1f tape on each kettle. Retain tiny black eyes. Remove highlights, tonal textures and claw lines on hands/feet. Preserve thin cream separating lines only where needed to distinguish overlapping black arms, paws and legs. Make labels solid black plain sans-serif. Do not change the six poses, kettle numbers 16 or layout. The whole page must be light paper with clear flat black character shapes.

specs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. This image is a STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE for a fair mascot comparison. Produce a matching sheet, replacing the BEAR with an adult LYNX in ALL SIX cells. Keep the identical 3-column by 2-row layout, same relative figure scale, same four poses, same simple flat fill language, same number of large shapes, same tiny black dot eyes constructed on a cream face area, same line weight, same kettle shapes and labels. LYNX: attentive collected friendly adult, subtle dry humor, never smug. Solid #111110 body with one simple light #e9e5dc muzzle/face patch and plain oval belly like reference. Adult head less than one third total standing height. ESSENTIAL lynx features: clearly pointed triangular ears with LARGE SIMPLE BLACK TUFTS projecting above each ear, broad angular cheek ruffs formed by two or three large silhouette corners, short bobtail. NO individual hairs, no whiskers, no scattered spots or leopard pattern; use NO spots at all. No claws, teeth, fur shading or realistic anatomy. Face tiny dot eyes and one short relaxed line for mouth, no superior squint. Upper left «Привет»: full standing lynx waves one paw, kettlebell separate on floor to viewer's right. Upper middle «Тренируемся»: same three-quarter side stance as bear, both paws grasp one kettle handle at chest height at top of swing, arms extended, no acrobatics, keep paper gaps showing grip. Upper right «Отдых»: seated lynx, relaxed paws, closed arc eyes, kettle beside. Lower left «Ждём»: seated lynx, one paw rests on kettle handle, head tilted curious and patient. Lower middle «Силуэт»: solid featureless standing lynx silhouette without kettle; EAR TUFTS MUST BE CLEARLY VISIBLE, short tail. Lower right «Голова»: close-up matching face with two tufted ears and simple angular cheeks, same small dot eyes as bear, not more detailed than bear. Kettlebell unchanged in every pose: black cast round body, flat base, open arch handle, cream 16, no eyes; ONE orange #ff7a1f tape on kettle handle, no orange elsewhere. No other objects, UI, devices or characters. Edge-to-edge FULLY OPAQUE warm paper #f4f2ed, not transparent, no dark background, vignette, gradients, grain, 3D, shading or highlights. Every black shape must be flat solid. Exact labels as given in black sans-serif. Do not make lynx more detailed, ornamented or anthropomorphically muscular than bear. No hands on hips.

refinements.prompt: Refine ONLY the lynx heads in all six panels of this sheet, preserving all body poses, kettle positions and 16, dimensions, labels, layout and flat paper palette. Currently the face looks like a bear wearing very tall forked cat ears. Make it unmistakably a simple adult LYNX: shorten triangular ears by roughly 25 percent and replace EVERY three-finger fork tuft with a SINGLE bold tapered black spike (like one brush-shaped triangle), one tuft at each ear tip. Tufts remain clearly visible in silhouette. Broaden muzzle horizontally into a single simple cream low angular feline cheek patch, merge it upward just enough to contain the same two tiny black dot eyes; replace the big round bear nose with a SMALL BLACK inverted triangular feline nose. Mouth only one tiny short relaxed line, no broad bear smile. No whiskers, spots, hairs, fur strokes, fangs, claws, eyelids or extra detail. Keep eyes the SAME dot size and neutral openness as currently, never smug. Cheek silhouette has only TWO broad angular corners per side rather than many saw teeth. Same head design in greeting, swing, rest, waiting and avatar; rest eyes remain closed short arcs. The silhouette panel must have the same shortened ears and two single tapered tufts with no internal details. Head including tufts should occupy less than one third of standing figure height. Keep flat solid #111110, cream #e9e5dc, opaque paper #f4f2ed, one orange kettle tape. No shading or textures.
